'''Langoonan deathmasks''' were masks created by the [[Langoonan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that were considered art by some [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. They were decorated with [[Gemstone/Legends|gems]] and precious metals.

==History==
Langoona deathmasks were masks created by the [[Langoonan]]<ref name="EA" /> [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Langoona]] in the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. The masks were made on islands within the warm [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of Langoona where they were decorated with semi-precious [[Gemstone/Legends|gems]] and inlays of [[Silver/Legends|silver]], [[Gold/Legends|gold]], [[Platinum/Legends|platinum]] and iridescent shells from the ocean. By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the masks were considered works of art worth a large amount. In 1 BBY, the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] leader of the [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] [[Kajidic/Legends|Kajidic]], [[Durga Besadii Tai]], gave a Langoonan deathmask to the Hutt leader of the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] kajidic, [[Jiliac Desilijic Tiron]], as a sign of [[Gender/Legends|his]] intentions to [[Death/Legends|kill]] her for having his father [[Aruk Besadii Aora]] murdered. Jiliac smashed the mask against a wall before Durga challenged her to combat under the Hutt [[Old Law]] and killed her.<ref name="RD" />

==Behind the scenes==
A Langoonan death mask first appeared in ''[[Rebel Dawn]]'' the third book in [[The Han Solo Trilogy (hardcover)|the ''Han Solo Trilogy'']] written by [[A. C. Crispin]] and released in [[1998]]. Deathmask is also spelt as death-mask once in the book, but this article uses the more common spelling. The name of the species who made them was revealed to be Langoonan in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].
